properties.displayName: SCF - Manual attestation for validating only service identities used by CICD have privileged access
properties.description: Only service identities used by the CI/CD solution are allowed to have privileged access permissions such as create, update and delete permissions on the CSP control plane. This control can be exempted for development environments.
